metadata.title: How to Review Extra Tags in TagWeaver | Android Screenshot Guide
metadata.description:
In TagWeaver’s Extra Tags screen, review a field name and its value, such as BPM or Comment.

Still-screen guide using a real Android emulator screenshot with repository-authored demonstration metadata. No navigation, taps, edits, deletion, saved result, or speed demonstration is shown. The example ISRC and copyright fields are demo values, not evidence of rights to a music recording.

Explore TagWeaver for Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onnellab.tagweaver2
